comments.author: Solid-Rhoads
comments.body_html: So if you want them back fast you can use the “Return_Time_Override”: in the configs and set the number of seconds (doesn’t have to be 60 or less, you can make this something like 600 for 10 mins). If you want control over the min and max number of hours for potential return I could add that, but it might be a little while before I get around to it. SVM gives you control over that already though if you don’t mind installing another mod and want that functionality immediately.
